query_analysis.original_query: We are designing a venting system for a scrubber that processes acidic gases. What safety factors should we consider in case of an emergency gas release?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop a comprehensive safety assessment for a venting system in an acidic gas scrubber, focusing on emergency gas release mitigation and safety protocol design

communication_strategy.information_flow: Comprehensive safety protocol development and risk mitigation strategy
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Integrated safety and technical design review

clarification_questions: What specific types of acidic gases are being processed?
What is the maximum potential gas release volume?
What are the ambient temperature and pressure conditions of the scrubber?
Are there any specific regulatory standards that must be met?
